name: Ethan
overview: Ethan was a male member of the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as the son of Zimmah. He belonged to the Gershonite clan, which descended from Gershon, the son of Levi. This places Ethan within the Levitical family responsible for specific religious duties in Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Ethan means 'long lived' or 'ever-flowing [streams],' reflecting qualities of endurance and continual provision. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 6:42 and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ethan as the son of Zimmah and infers that Adaiah was his father. Beyond these, no additional family relationships are noted in the biblical text for this Ethan.
scriptureSignificance: Ethan's significance lies in his role as a member of the Levite tribe, specifically among the Gershonites, who had distinct responsibilities in the tabernacle service. His mention in the genealogical record of 1 Chronicles 6:42 underscores the importance of preserving the Levitical lineage for maintaining the worship and service of God among Israel.
